verdict.rationale: BILL's documented REST v3 API covers Spend & Expense directly: budgets, users, virtual cards, transactions and reimbursements. That lets the product be driven headlessly without the UI. A no-real-money sandbox and webhooks support automated test and event-driven workflows. missing for 10: an official CLI or CI-specific guidance (e.g., service-account/non-interactive auth docs), deeper S&E-specific endpoint evidence beyond AP examples, and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.
